field.permissionHint: Tap the sensor button and allow motion access.
field.manual: Explore by touch · tap the sensor button to resume
field.gyroAlign: Align one bright star to start tracking
field.gyroHint: Uses no magnetometer. Align one bright star, then move your phone. Realign if the view drifts. A new alignment is needed after restarting the app.
field.gyroUnavailable: A magnetometer-free sensor is unavailable here. Choose automatic tracking or explore by touch.
field.compassHint: Uses the compass to find north. Near magnets or metal, switch to the gyroscope and align a star.
field.correctionHint: Tracking continues. Move away from magnets or metal, or use the gyroscope and align a star.

camera.hint: Video stays on your device and is never saved or uploaded. Lens coverage varies: adjust while comparing a real star. This is not precision image alignment.

error.unsupported: Camera preview is unavailable in this environment.
error.timeout: Camera connection timed out. Check permission and try again.
error.denied: Allow camera access in app permissions, then try again.
error.unavailable: The rear camera could not be opened. Close other camera apps and try again.
error.interrupted: The camera connection ended. Turn it on again when needed.

field.colorEstimate: Estimated from catalog data. Perceived color depends on observing conditions.
field.sketchShareHint: Only the sketch image is shared, without your observing location or private notes. You can review it before posting.
field.sketchMissing: The sketch file could not be found.
field.sketchShareFailed: Sharing could not start. Please try again.
